auth.v1.CreateApiKeyRequest.description:
CreateApiKeyRequest creates a new API key. Clients generate the Ed25519 key
 pair locally and submit only the public key.

color.description: Optional user-chosen color token for UI display.
color.title: color

icon.description: Optional user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display.
icon.title: icon

ipWhitelist.description:
Optional CIDR whitelist. Empty means no IP restriction. Maximum 32 unique
 entries.

items.description:
string.ip_with_prefixlen = true // value must be a valid IP prefix
string.ip_with_prefixlen_empty = true // value is empty, which is not a valid IP prefix

ipWhitelist.title: ip_whitelist

label.description: Human-readable label for the key. Required; 1 to 64 characters.
label.title: label

publicKeyEd25519.description:
Ed25519 public key bytes. Must be exactly 32 bytes. The private key or seed
 must never be sent to the API.
bytes.const = []
publicKeyEd25519.title: public_key_ed25519

subaccountId.description:
Optional sub-account to scope this key to (opaque ID). If unset, the key is
 root-level.
subaccountId.title: subaccount_id

auth.v1.CreateApiKeyRequest.title: CreateApiKeyRequest

auth.v1.CreateApiKeyResponse.description: CreateApiKeyResponse returns the created API key metadata.

apiKey.description: Created API key metadata. The private key or seed is never returned.
apiKey.title: api_key

auth.v1.CreateApiKeyResponse.title: CreateApiKeyResponse

auth.v1.DeleteApiKeyResponse.description: DeleteApiKeyResponse is empty when revocation succeeds.
auth.v1.DeleteApiKeyResponse.title: DeleteApiKeyResponse

auth.v1.GetApiKeyResponse.description: GetApiKeyResponse returns one API key owned by the caller.
auth.v1.GetApiKeyResponse.title: GetApiKeyResponse

auth.v1.IpWhitelist.description: IpWhitelist replaces or clears an API key IP whitelist during updates.

cidrs.description: CIDR strings, e.g. "1.2.3.4/32". Maximum 32 unique entries.

items.description:
string.ip_with_prefixlen = true // value must be a valid IP prefix
string.ip_with_prefixlen_empty = true // value is empty, which is not a valid IP prefix

cidrs.title: cidrs

auth.v1.IpWhitelist.title: IpWhitelist

auth.v1.ListApiKeysResponse.description: ListApiKeysResponse contains matching API keys, newest first by creation time.

apiKeys.description: Matching API keys, newest first. Revoked keys are excluded.
apiKeys.title: api_keys

auth.v1.ListApiKeysResponse.title: ListApiKeysResponse

auth.v1.UpdateApiKeyResponse.description: UpdateApiKeyResponse returns the API key after applying the update.
auth.v1.UpdateApiKeyResponse.title: UpdateApiKeyResponse

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: List non-revoked API keys for the caller account, newest first, optionally filtered by sub-account.

parameters.description:
Optional filter: only keys scoped to this sub-account (opaque ID). If unset,
 all non-revoked keys owned by the caller are returned.
parameters.name: subaccountId

schema.description:
Optional filter: only keys scoped to this sub-account (opaque ID). If unset,
 all non-revoked keys owned by the caller are returned.
schema.title: subaccount_id

post.description: Create a new API key for the caller account, including public key material and metadata.

delete.description: Revoke an API key owned by the caller account. Revocation is permanent.

parameters.description:
Opaque API key identifier (e.g. "ak_<hex>"). This is the stable public
 handle for a key.
parameters.name: key_id

schema.description:
Opaque API key identifier (e.g. "ak_<hex>"). This is the stable public
 handle for a key.
schema.title: key_id

get.description: Retrieve a single API key owned by the caller account.

parameters.description:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.
parameters.name: key_id

schema.description:
Opaque API key identifier, formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hex
 characters.
schema.title: key_id

patch.description: Update mutable API key fields, including label, status, whitelist, and expiry.

parameters.description: Opaque API key identifier to update.
parameters.name: key_id

schema.description: Opaque API key identifier to update.
schema.title: key_id

parameters.description:
Optional new expiry time in UTC. If this field is present:
 - Non-zero timestamp sets/updates the expiry.
 - Zero/epoch timestamp clears the expiry (no automatic expiry).
 If this field is omitted, the expiry is left unchanged.
parameters.name: expiresAt

schema.description:
UpdateApiKeyRequest updates mutable metadata for an existing API key.
expires_at_future_or_zero // expires_at must be in the future or zero

color.description: New user-chosen color token for UI display. If empty, left unchanged.
color.title: color

expiresAt.description:
Optional new expiry time in UTC. If this field is present:
 - Non-zero timestamp sets/updates the expiry.
 - Zero/epoch timestamp clears the expiry (no automatic expiry).
 If this field is omitted, the expiry is left unchanged.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

icon.description: New user-chosen icon/emoji for UI display. If empty, left unchanged.
icon.title: icon

ipWhitelist.description:
Optional new IP whitelist. If this field is omitted, the whitelist is left
 unchanged. If it is present:
 - cidrs non-empty replaces the existing whitelist.
 - cidrs empty clears the whitelist (no IP restriction).
ipWhitelist.title: ip_whitelist

label.description:
New human-friendly label for the key. If empty, label is left unchanged.
 Maximum length is 64 characters.
label.title: label

status.description:
Optional new status. ACTIVE and DISABLED are allowed; REVOKED must be done
 via DeleteApiKey and is terminal.
status.title: status
